subject: Your Application Will Expire Tomorrow!
heading: Your Application Will Expire Tomorrow!
body:
Hi {{{applicantFirstName}}},

Your {{{org_name}}} {{{product_name}}} application is about to expire. Please complete any remaining tasks so we can review your application and make a final decision.If your application is not completed by tomorrow, your application will be canceled and you will need to reapply.

You can finish your tasks by logging in.
